title: daucus pumilus subsp. minusculus
intro: Daucus pumilus subsp. minusculus, commonly known as Dwarf Carrot, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Apiaceae family, often found in mountainous regions. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Carrot include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may help to soothe digestive issues and support overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Carrot include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, although further research is necessary to fully understand its potential therapeutic effects.
